jei.tieredpower.info.coal_generator: Burns any furnace fuel (including other mods' fuels) to make 40 FE/t. Pushes power into cables and machines on every side.
jei.tieredpower.info.battery_box: Stores energy. Five tiers: Battery Box (1M FE, 8,000 FE/t), Advanced (8M, 32,000 FE/t), Elite (32M, 128,000 FE/t), Ultimate (256M, 512,000 FE/t), Quantum (2,000M, 2,048,000 FE/t). Each face is Input, Output or Disabled - shift + right-click a face with an empty hand to cycle it. When placed, the face pointing at you is the Input and the other five faces are Outputs. Keeps its stored energy when mined.
jei.tieredpower.info.boiler: Boils water into steam for a Steam Turbine placed directly ON TOP. Heat: any furnace fuel or lava in its tank (100%), or lava, magma, fire or a lit campfire directly underneath (50%, free). Water: adjacent water source blocks, sinks, tanks, pipes or buckets.
jei.tieredpower.info.steam_turbine: Place directly on top of a Boiler. Spins up over ~5 seconds and turns 1 mB of steam into 2 FE, up to 200 FE/t. Outputs power on every side except the bottom.
jei.tieredpower.info.charger: Charges any Forge Energy item from any mod at up to 8,000 FE/t. Fully charged items move to the output slot, so a hopper underneath can collect them.
jei.tieredpower.info.fusion_reactor: 1) Charge it with 1,000,000 FE while it's off. 2) Load a Deuterium and a Tritium cell - it ignites automatically. 3) Makes up to 8,000 FE/t (more with Plasma Coils); each pair lasts 2 minutes. If fuel runs out it cools over ~25 s; refuel in time or it needs re-igniting. Use Diamond or Netherite cable on its output.
jei.tieredpower.info.lithium_ore: Generates below Y=0, mostly in deepslate. Needs an iron pickaxe. Drops Raw Lithium; Fortune works.
jei.tieredpower.info.cable: Carries up to %s FE/t of Forge Energy. Connects to machines, generators and batteries from any mod that uses FE. Different tiers can be joined together.
tooltip.tieredpower.speed_upgrade: +50% machine speed each, but +75% power per tick
tooltip.tieredpower.upgrade_slots: Up to 4 in: Electric Furnace, Pulverizer, Alloy Smelter, Electrolyzer
jei.tieredpower.info.upgrades: Put these in the upgrade slots on the left of the Electric Furnace, Pulverizer, Alloy Smelter or Electrolyzer. Up to 4 of each. Speed: +50% speed each, +75% power per tick. Efficiency: -15% power per tick each. 4 Speed + 4 Efficiency = 3x speed at about 1.3x the power per tick.
jei.tieredpower.info.fusion_multiblock: Multiblock Fusion Reactor: any rectangular box from 3x3x3 up to 13x13x13. Edges and corners: Reactor Casing. Walls: Casing, Reactor Glass, Fuel Ports and Power Ports (at least one of each). Build the Fusion Controller into a side wall (not an edge), front facing out. Inside: Magnet Coils or air - every coil adds 1,500 FE/t on top of the 4,000 FE/t base. Right-click the controller to check the structure; it names any wrong block. Charge it with 5,000,000 FE through a Power Port, then load Deuterium + Tritium cells. Reactors with more than 27 coils burn fuel proportionally faster.
jei.tieredpower.info.magnet_coil: Goes inside the multiblock Fusion Reactor. Base output is 4,000 FE/t and each coil adds 1,500 FE/t. Up to 27 coils, each fuel pair lasts 2 minutes; bigger reactors burn fuel faster but make far more power.
jei.tieredpower.info.reactor_fuel_port: Face block of the multiblock Fusion Reactor. Hoppers and pipes insert Deuterium and Tritium cells here and extract empty cells.
jei.tieredpower.info.reactor_power_port: Wall block of the multiblock Fusion Reactor. Feed ignition power in here while the reactor is off; once running it pushes up to 512,000 FE/t per side into cables. Big reactors need several Power Ports and Netherite cable.
jei.tieredpower.info.energy_bank: Energy Bank: any rectangular box from 3x3x3 up to 13x13x13. Edges and corners: Bank Casing. Walls: Bank Casing, Bank Glass and Bank Ports (at least one port). Build the Bank Controller into a side wall (not an edge), front facing out. Inside: Energy Cells (any mix of tiers) or air - every cell adds capacity. Right-click the controller to check the structure; it names any wrong block. Breaking the structure keeps the energy, but nothing flows until it's rebuilt.
jei.tieredpower.info.bank_port: Wall block of the Energy Bank. Input ports accept power, Output ports push power into cables. Shift + right-click with an empty hand to switch. Each port moves up to 1,000,000 FE/t - add more ports for more throughput.
jei.tieredpower.info.energy_cell: Goes inside an Energy Bank. Energy Cell: 32M FE. Advanced: 256M FE. Ultimate: 2,048M FE. Quantum: 16,384M FE. Mix tiers freely.
jei.tieredpower.info.wrench: Right-click a machine to rotate it, a Battery Box face to cycle Input/Output/Disabled, or a Bank Port to switch it. Shift + right-click any Tiered Industries block to pick it up with its items, energy and settings kept.
jei.tieredpower.info.sink: Endless water. Pushes water into any tank or machine next to it (Boiler, Electrolyzer, other mods' tanks) and fills buckets. Needs no water source or power.
jei.tieredpower.info.electric_pump: Place it above a lake or lava pool (it looks straight down through air to find the fluid). Pumps 1 bucket per second (faster with Speed Upgrades) from anywhere in the connected fluid within 32 blocks. Water is left in place, so it never runs out; lava and other fluids are removed. Pushes what it pumps into tanks or machines beside or above it.
jei.tieredpower.info.rock_crusher: Crushes the blocks you put in: stone -> cobblestone -> gravel -> sand, sandstone -> sand, granite/diorite/andesite/tuff/calcite/deepslate -> gravel, glass -> sand, and more. It also breaks any ore block - stone or deepslate - into raw materials: raw iron, copper, gold, uranium and lithium (2 each, copper 5), or the gem, dust or scrap the ore holds. Recipes are data files, so you can add your own.
jei.tieredpower.info.freezer: 9 Ice -> Packed Ice and 9 Packed Ice -> Blue Ice (input slot). With nothing to compress it freezes its tank: 1,000 mB water -> Ice, 1,000 mB lava -> Obsidian. Pulls water or lava from neighbouring tanks, sinks and pumps; buckets work too.
jei.tieredpower.info.fluid_tank: Holds one fluid: Basic 16 buckets, Advanced 64, Elite 256, Ultimate 1,024. The fluid shows through the glass. Buckets and pipes work on any side, and it keeps its contents when mined. Comparators read how full it is. Right-click with an empty hand to see what's inside.
jei.tieredpower.info.fluid_pipe: Carries liquids (water, lava, other mods' liquids) at up to %s mB/t per connection. Connected pipes share one network carrying one fluid at a time; length doesn't matter. Pipes push into tanks and machines they touch. Right-click a connection with the Wrench to cycle its mode: Push (delivers into that block, the default) -> Pull (takes out of it, orange ring) -> Push + Pull (orange/green ring) -> Disabled (grey cap, not connected). Between two pipes it just connects/disconnects them. A Pull only moves things when something else on the same network is set to Push.
jei.tieredpower.info.gas_pipe: Carries gases - fluids lighter than air, such as Steam - at up to %s mB/t per connection. Use it to pipe steam from Boilers to Steam Turbines anywhere. (Mekanism's gases use their own system and need Mekanism's tubes.) Right-click a connection with the Wrench to cycle its mode: Push (delivers into that block, the default) -> Pull (takes out of it, orange ring) -> Push + Pull (orange/green ring) -> Disabled (grey cap, not connected). Between two pipes it just connects/disconnects them. A Pull only moves things when something else on the same network is set to Push.
jei.tieredpower.info.quarry: Mines an area layer by layer. Its GUI lets you set the area size (3x3 to 65x65), whether the area is centred on the quarry or behind it, how deep to dig (Bottom Y; shift-click for 10 at a time), and the tool: Normal, Silk Touch or Fortune III (50% more power). Items placed in the Void slots are thrown away. Skips fluids, unbreakable blocks and anything with an inventory. Items go into its buffer and are pushed into neighbouring chests or Item Pipes. Pair it with a Chunk Loader.
jei.tieredpower.info.crop_farmer: Tends a 9x9 area at its own height. Plants crop seeds, nether wart, melon and pumpkin seeds, cactus, and Sugar Cane Seeds (sand/dirt with water beside it). Fertilizer or bone meal in the far-left slot grows plants a step at a time (32 steps per Fertilizer). Next to a storage cable it restocks fertilizer and seeds from the network.
jei.tieredpower.info.auto_crafter: Crafts one recipe over and over. Click items into the 3x3 pattern grid to set the recipe - they're ghost items and aren't used up. Ingredients are pulled from chests or inventories next to it; the result goes to its output slot (hoppers and pipes can empty it). Leftover containers such as empty buckets are put back into a neighbouring inventory.
jei.tieredpower.info.chunk_loader: Keeps a square of chunks around it loaded while it has power - up to 5x5, or 7x7 / 9x9 / 11x11 / 15x15 with Tier Installers (Advanced to Quantum). Click the size button in its GUI for a bigger area, right-click for smaller. Costs 20 FE/t per chunk (config), less with Efficiency Upgrades. Releases the chunks when it runs out of power, is switched off with redstone, or is broken.
jei.tieredpower.info.item_pipe: Moves items between inventories - chests, machines, Storage Drawers, AE2 ME Interfaces, Refined Storage Interfaces, Sophisticated Storage and more. Items pushed in are delivered to the other inventories on the network (never back into the sender) and glide visibly along the pipes. Right-click a connection with an empty hand to set its priority 0-9 (higher fills first). Right-click a connection holding an Item Filter to install it; shift + right-click with an empty hand to take it off. Right-click a connection with the Wrench to cycle its mode: Push (delivers into that block, the default) -> Pull (takes out of it, orange ring) -> Push + Pull (orange/green ring) -> Disabled (grey cap, not connected). Between two pipes it just connects/disconnects them. A Pull only moves things when something else on the same network is set to Push. Pull rate: up to %s items/s.
jei.tieredpower.info.item_filter: Right-click in the air to set up to 9 items, Allow/Block, and Match by Item (exact), Tag (shares a tag - one raw ore matches all raw ores) or Mod (same mod). Right-click an Item Pipe connection with it to install it there. An empty filter lets everything through.
jei.tieredpower.info.electric_drill: Mines anything a pickaxe or shovel can, at diamond level. Uses 100 FE per block instead of durability (100,000 FE). Charge it in a Charger, Wireless Charger or Portable Battery.
jei.tieredpower.info.advanced_drill: Netherite-level, faster, 1,000,000 FE. Shift + right-click in the air to switch between single-block and 3x3 mining (200 FE per block).
jei.tieredpower.info.electric_chainsaw: Cuts anything an axe can, plus leaves and cobwebs. Breaking a log fells the whole tree (up to 128 logs); sneak to cut just one. 100 FE per block.
jei.tieredpower.info.jetpack: Wear it in the chest slot and hold jump to fly. Uses energy only while thrusting and stops fall damage while it has charge. The Advanced Jetpack climbs faster, holds 10x the energy and gives more protection. On a dedicated server, set allow-flight=true in server.properties.
jei.tieredpower.info.portable_battery: Right-click to switch on: it charges every other powered item in your inventory and armour (drills, jetpacks, other mods' tools). Charge it like any powered item.
jei.tieredpower.info.wireless_charger: Charges the powered items carried or worn by every player within 16 blocks, up to 16,000 FE/t each. Power it with cables like any machine.
jei.tieredpower.info.solar_panel: Makes power in daylight when nothing blocks its view of the sky; half power in rain, nothing at night. Solar Panel 20 FE/t, Advanced 100, Elite 450, Ultimate 2,000, Quantum 9,000. Each tier is made from 4 of the tier below. Pushes power down and sideways into cables.
jei.tieredpower.info.wind_turbine: Makes power from wind: nothing at sea level (Y 64), rising to 128 FE/t at Y 256. Rain gives x1.5 and thunderstorms x2. Blocks within 3 blocks of it slow it down - give it open space on a hill or tower.
jei.tieredpower.info.fission_reactor: Holds up to 4 Uranium Fuel Rods (5 minutes each; they come back as Depleted Fuel Rods). Each rod makes up to 800 FE/t, reaching full power once the reactor is 50% hot. Above 50% it cools itself with water (Sink, Pump or pipes) and turns that water into steam, which it pushes into Gas Pipes or Steam Turbines for bonus power. Without water it overheats and SCRAMs (shuts down until cool). Meltdown explosions can be switched on in the config. It's also needed to craft the Fission Controller for the multiblock reactor.
jei.tieredpower.info.uranium_ore: Found underground from Y 24 down to the bottom of the world, most common deep down. Glows faintly. Needs an iron pickaxe. Works with other mods' uranium via the forge:ingots/uranium tag.
jei.tieredpower.info.fission_multiblock: Multiblock Fission Reactor: any box from 3x3x3 to 13x13x13. Edges and corners: Fission Casing. Walls: Fission Casing, Fission Glass, and at least one Fuel Port, Coolant Port and Power Port, plus the Fission Controller facing out. Inside: at least one Fuel Assembly; the rest can be Coolant Channels or left empty - once formed, the reactor floods the empty space with water from its Coolant Ports, and every water block helps cool it. Right-click the controller to check the structure (the ports only work once it's formed).
jei.tieredpower.info.fuel_assembly: Goes inside the multiblock Fission Reactor. Each makes up to 1,000 FE/t at full heat and adds 1 heat per tick. Every other assembly touching it adds +10% efficiency - pack them together for power, but they run hot. Each rod lasts 6,000 assembly-ticks. Glows while the reactor runs.
jei.tieredpower.info.coolant_channel: Optional, goes inside the multiblock Fission Reactor. Each channel removes 10 heat per tick with water - five times a water block's 2 - so it's the compact way to cool a big core.
jei.tieredpower.info.fission_ports: Wall blocks of the multiblock Fission Reactor (they only work once it's formed). Fuel Port: fuel rods IN - right-click it holding rods, or feed it with hoppers / Item Pipes. Right-click with an empty hand to see how much is loaded. Waste Port (optional): pushes depleted rods OUT into an Item Pipe, chest or hopper next to it - send them to a Pulverizer to recover uranium. Coolant Port: water in (it floods the inside first), steam out into Gas Pipes or turbines. Power Port: pushes power into cables, up to 64,000 FE/t per side.
jei.tieredpower.info.enchanting_machine: Enchants items with power instead of your XP. Put an enchantable item or a book in the left slot and lapis in the middle, and pick level 10, 20 or 30 with the button (1 lapis per 10 levels). Books come out as enchanted books. Level 30 takes 15 seconds at 400 FE/t. Give it Liquid Experience (by pipe or bucket) and it enchants on XP instead of power, twice as fast: 40 mB per enchantment level.
jei.tieredpower.info.mob_grinder: Attacks mobs in a 5x3x5 area in front of it, as if a player hit them - so they drop player-only loot and XP. Collects the drops into its buffer (auto-output and pipes work) and stores the XP: click the XP button in its GUI to take it. The button at the top switches between hostile mobs only and all mobs. It never harms players, bosses, name-tagged mobs, tamed pets or armour stands. The XP it collects can also be piped out as Liquid Experience (20 mB per point) - it pushes it into tanks and machines next to it, such as an Enchanting Machine.
jei.tieredpower.info.spawner_controller: Place it touching a vanilla mob spawner. While powered (200 FE/t), the spawner works without a player nearby and spawns much faster and more mobs at a time; Speed Upgrades push it further. Without power the spawner goes back to its original settings. Put a Mob Grinder in front of the spawner for a complete mob farm.
jei.tieredpower.info.fluid_mixer: Mixes fluids with items: any concrete powder + 250 mB water gives concrete of the same colour; dirt + 250 mB water gives mud; with the input slot empty, 1,000 mB lava + 1,000 mB water gives obsidian. Pulls water and lava from a Sink, Pump, pipes or tanks next to it.
jei.tieredpower.info.teleporter: Right-click a pad with an empty hand to name it and pick where it sends you - every pad in the world is listed, in any dimension. Then stand on the pad and crouch to travel. The Teleporter Linker is a quick way to link two pads to each other. Costs 1,000 FE + 20 FE per block, or 50,000 FE between dimensions, from the pad you leave from.
jei.tieredpower.info.condenser: Turns steam back into water: 10 mB of steam makes 1 mB of water, up to 1,000 mB of steam per tick, no power needed. It takes steam from Gas Pipes, Boilers or reactors next to it and pushes the water into anything that accepts water. Put one between a Fission Reactor's Coolant Port and a Fluid Pipe back into the reactor for a closed water loop.
jei.tieredpower.info.gas_electrolyzer: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen: 10 mB of water becomes 20 mB of hydrogen and 10 mB of oxygen every tick, using 200 FE/t (Speed Upgrades make it faster). Pulls water from a Sink, Pump or pipes and pushes both gases out into Gas Pipes, Fluid Tanks or a Gas Burner Generator. Put a Hydrogen Jetpack in its slot to refuel it.
jei.tieredpower.info.gas_burner_generato: Burns gas for power, up to 40 mB/t. Hydrogen: 7 FE per mB (9 with half as much oxygen). Methane from a Bio-Digester: 12 FE per mB (15 with the same amount of oxygen). Hydrogen is used first. Idles when full.
jei.tieredpower.info.steam_engine: A cheap early steam generator: up to 40 mB of steam per tick at 1 FE per mB (40 FE/t), no spin-up. Takes steam from a Boiler, Gas Pipes or a reactor next to it. The Steam Turbine is twice as efficient.
jei.tieredpower.info.steam_hammer: Runs Pulverizer recipes (ore doubling and more) on steam instead of power: 20 mB of steam per tick, 7.5 seconds per item. Speed Upgrades make it faster. A good use for leftover boiler or reactor steam.
jei.tieredpower.info.hydrogen_jetpack: A jetpack that burns hydrogen instead of FE: 64,000 mB, 2 mB per tick while thrusting - over 25 minutes of flight. Refuel it in a Gas Electrolyzer's slot.
jei.tieredpower.info.energy_meter: Put it in a cable line: power goes in the LEFT side and out the RIGHT side as you look at its screen. The screen shows FE per tick and a running total. Right-click for peak and total; sneak + right-click resets them. A redstone signal switches the flow off, so it doubles as a power switch. A comparator reads how much is flowing.
jei.tieredpower.info.power_monitor: Place it touching any cable. Its screen shows the whole cable network: power coming in, power used by machines, power going into batteries, and how full the batteries are. Right-click for the full readout. A comparator reads how full the batteries are (0-15) - handy for switching generators on when power runs low.
jei.tieredpower.info.multimeter: Right-click a cable to see its whole network: power in, to machines, into storage and stored. Right-click any other block (from any mod) to see its stored energy, what it's generating and what's in its tanks. Machines don't open their screens when you use it.
jei.tieredpower.info.storage_controller: The heart of an item storage network. Connect Drive Bays and Storage Terminals to it with Storage Cable (or place them touching). Needs 20 FE/t plus 5 FE/t per Drive Bay. Only one controller per network. It also works as one big inventory: Item Pipes and hoppers can put items in and pull them out. Right-click it for its status.
jei.tieredpower.info.storage_cable: Links the parts of an item storage network: the Storage Controller, Drive Bays and Storage Terminals. It carries no power - the controller needs a normal energy cable.
jei.tieredpower.info.drive_bay: Holds 8 Storage Disks for the storage network. Glows when its network is online.
jei.tieredpower.info.storage_terminal: Shows everything in the storage network. Click to take a stack, right-click for half, shift-click to send it to your inventory. Click the grid with an item held to store it (right-click stores one). Shift-click items in your inventory to store them. Type to search, or @modname to search by mod.
jei.tieredpower.info.storage_disk_4k: Storage Disks go in a Drive Bay. 4K, 16K, 64K and 256K hold that many items (4,096 to 262,144), up to 63 different item types each. Contents stay on the disk when it's removed.
jei.tieredpower.info.crafting_terminal: A Storage Terminal with a 3x3 crafting grid. Craft straight from storage: when a craft uses up a grid slot, it refills from storage, so shift-clicking the result crafts as many as you have materials for. The x button puts the grid back into storage, and closing the terminal does the same. With JEI, open a crafting recipe and press + to fill the grid from storage (shift + for a stack of each).
jei.tieredpower.info.import_bus: Place it against a chest, furnace or machine: it pulls items out of it into the storage network (8 items every half second). Right-click to set a filter - with an empty filter it takes everything.
jei.tieredpower.info.export_bus: Place it against a chest, furnace or machine: it keeps pushing the items in its filter from the storage network into it (8 items every half second). Right-click to choose which items. Great for feeding ore into a Pulverizer or fuel into a Coal Generator.
jei.tieredpower.info.storage_terminal_pa: A flat Storage Terminal for walls, floors and ceilings. Place it on a Storage Cable or any storage block - the screen faces away from the surface you click. Craft it from a Storage Terminal block and back again.
jei.tieredpower.info.crafting_terminal_p: A flat Crafting Terminal for walls, floors and ceilings. Place it on a Storage Cable or any storage block. Craft it from a Crafting Terminal block (and back), or from a Storage Terminal Panel plus a crafting table.
jei.tieredpower.info.storage_interface: A doorway into storage from anywhere on the Storage Cable. Machines, pipes and reactors next to it can push items, fluids and gases into storage, or pull them out, as if it were one huge chest and tank.
jei.tieredpower.info.fluid_disk_4k: Holds fluids and gases (water, lava, steam, hydrogen, oxygen and other mods' fluids) - put it in a Drive Bay. 4K, 16K, 64K and 256K hold that many buckets, up to 63 types each. Contents stay on the disk when it's removed.
jei.tieredpower.info.wireless_terminal: Your storage in your hand. Sneak + right-click a Storage Controller to link it, then right-click anywhere within 64 blocks (same dimension) to open it. Runs on FE (5 FE/t while open) - charge it in a Charger, Wireless Charger or Portable Battery. Tip: set the Open Wireless Terminal key in Controls to open it from your inventory.
jei.tieredpower.info.wireless_crafting_t: A Wireless Terminal with a crafting grid - works like the Crafting Terminal, JEI + button included. Link and charge it the same way.
jei.tieredpower.info.wireless_access_poi: Put it anywhere on a storage network (touching Storage Cable or another storage block): Wireless Terminals linked to that network then work within 128 blocks of it, as well as 64 blocks of the controller. Use several to cover a big base. Adds 10 FE/t to the controller's power use and glows while the network is online.
jei.tieredpower.info.creative_energy_cel: Creative only. Unlimited power: pushes as much as anything next to it will take, every tick, and cables can draw as much as they like.
jei.tieredpower.info.creative_storage_di: Creative only. A storage disk with practically unlimited room (still 63 item types).
jei.tieredpower.info.creative_fluid_disk: Creative only. A fluid disk with practically unlimited room (still 63 fluid and gas types).
jei.tieredpower.info.pattern_encoder: Records recipes onto patterns. C/P switches between Crafting (crafting-table recipes; S = substitutes, e.g. any planks) and Processing (machine recipes with amounts and up to 3 outputs). Click items into the grid (copies only) or press + in JEI - it works on machine recipes too. Put in a Blank Pattern, press Encode, take the pattern out.
jei.tieredpower.info.molecular_assembler: Holds up to 27 patterns and 2 upgrades. Crafting patterns are crafted inside it (one every 8 ticks, +1 per Speed Upgrade). Processing patterns are done by the machine touching it - any face of this mod's machines works - and it sends item and fluid inputs in and pulls results back to storage. Touching an Electric Furnace, it also gives the network every furnace recipe without patterns. Several assemblers can share one machine.
jei.tieredpower.info.crafting_cpu: Lets the storage network run crafting jobs - 1 at a time per Basic CPU, 2 Advanced, 4 Elite, 8 Quantum (extra jobs queue). Raise its tier with Crafting Upgrades. Right-click to see the jobs and how far along they are; sneak + right-click to cancel them. Uses 10 FE/t per job slot on the controller.
jei.tieredpower.info.blank_pattern: Encode it in a Pattern Encoder. A Crafting Pattern can be wiped back to blank with sneak + right-click.
jei.tieredpower.info.stock_keeper: Keeps up to 9 items in stock. Click a slot with an item to add it (it keeps 64 to start), click it again to select it, type how many to keep and press Set. Every 5 seconds, if storage has fewer, it starts a crafting job for the difference (needs patterns, an assembler and a CPU). The bar under each slot shows green = in stock, blue = crafting, red = can't craft.
jei.tieredpower.info.lightning_collector: Put a vanilla Lightning Rod on top of it (or on a side). During thunderstorms the rod attracts lightning from up to 128 blocks away, and every strike adds 2,500,000 FE to the collector. It holds 25,000,000 FE and feeds it out at up to 20,000 FE/t on every side. Glows after a strike; a comparator reads how full it is.
jei.tieredpower.info.geothermal_generato: Free power from heat: 20 FE/t for each lava source block touching it (any of its six sides, up to 120 FE/t) and 5 FE/t for each magma block. Uses nothing up.
jei.tieredpower.info.water_wheel: Free power from moving water: 8 FE/t for each side (north, south, east, west) with flowing water next to it, up to 32 FE/t. Still water (source blocks) doesn't turn it.
jei.tieredpower.info.storm_caller: Calls a thunderstorm when you want one: once it has 4,000,000 FE and a Storm Charge, it uses both to start a 5-minute storm (only in dimensions with weather, and not while it's already storming). It follows its redstone setting, so a lever - or a comparator on a Lightning Collector - can decide when. Pair it with Lightning Collectors.
jei.tieredpower.info.isotope_separator: Pulls deuterium out of water for fusion: 100 mB of water becomes 2 mB of deuterium gas each tick (faster with Speed Upgrades), using 200 FE/t. Pushes deuterium into Gas Pipes, or straight into a Fusion Reactor next to it.
jei.tieredpower.info.air_separator: Splits air into nitrogen and oxygen - just power, no inputs: 16 mB nitrogen + 4 mB oxygen per tick, 120 FE/t. Needs a side open to the air. Pushes both gases into Gas Pipes.
jei.tieredpower.info.tritium_breeder: Breeds tritium for fusion: place it against a running Fission Reactor (or Fission Controller) and give it lithium ingots. Each ingot becomes 250 mB of tritium gas - one fusion fuel pair - in 20 seconds. Needs no power.
jei.tieredpower.info.cryo_injector: Place it against a Fission Reactor (or Fission Controller) and pipe nitrogen in: while it feeds 20 mB of nitrogen per tick, the reactor makes 50% more power.
jei.tieredpower.info.oxygen_furnace: Oxygen-blown steelmaking: 1 iron ingot (or iron dust) + 100 mB of oxygen = 1 steel ingot in 3 seconds, using 80 FE/t and no coal. Pipe oxygen in from an Air Separator or Gas Electrolyzer. Speed Upgrades make it faster.
jei.tieredpower.info.bio_digester: Rots crops, seeds, saplings, leaves, flowers, rotten flesh and other plant or animal matter into methane: 200 mB per item, one every 2 seconds, no power needed. Pipe the methane to a Gas Burner Generator (12 FE per mB, 15 with oxygen).
jei.tieredpower.info.advanced_installer: Right-click a processing machine (Electric Furnace, Pulverizer, Alloy Smelter, Compressor, Electric Sawmill, Ore Purifier, Rock Crusher, Fluid Mixer, Chemical Washer) to upgrade it in place: Advanced runs 3 operations at once, then Elite 5, Ultimate 7 and Quantum 9. Install them in order. Contents and settings are kept, and the installers drop back out if the machine is broken.
jei.tieredpower.info.muffler: Right-click any machine to silence it. Remove it again from the machine's Upgrades window (the arrow button at the top of its screen).
jei.tieredpower.info.quarry_planner: Marks out exactly where a Quarry digs: right-click one corner block, then the opposite corner, then your Quarry. It digs that rectangle (up to 65 x 65) from the higher corner's level down. The Quarry's Centred/Behind button switches back. Sneak + right-click the air to clear the corners.
jei.tieredpower.info.disk_workbench: Set up a Storage or Fluid Disk: put it in, then click items (or a bucket/tank for fluids) into its partition - the disk then only takes those (empty = anything). Fill partitions it to what's already stored; Clear removes the partition. Priority -9 to +9: higher disks fill first. Settings stay on the disk.
jei.tieredpower.info.security_terminal: Locks the storage network it's on to you (whoever places it) and the players you add by name. Others can't open its terminals or Drive Bays, use wireless terminals or buses on it, break its blocks, or place storage parts and pipes against it. Server operators can always get in. A network without a Security Terminal is open to everyone.
jei.tieredpower.info.reactor_gauge: Shows a reactor's heat (or a fusion reactor's plasma temperature), power, status and add-ons on its face. On a multiblock Fission or Fusion reactor, build it into the wall in place of any Casing or Glass block (not edges or corners) - the controller links it. On a single-block reactor, place it against the reactor. A comparator reads the heat (0-15).
jei.tieredpower.info.neutron_reflector: Right-click a Fission Reactor or Fission Controller to fit it: fuel rods last 50% longer. Drops back out if the reactor is broken.
jei.tieredpower.info.salt_evaporator: Boils water down to salt: 1,000 mB of water makes 1 salt in 5 seconds, using 40 FE/t. Takes water from a Sink, Pump or pipes.
jei.tieredpower.info.brine_electrolyzer: Electrolyses salt water: 1 salt + 500 mB of water = 250 mB of chlorine + 250 mB of hydrogen, in 2 seconds at 200 FE/t. Pushes both gases into Gas Pipes; the hydrogen can fuel a Gas Burner Generator.
jei.tieredpower.info.chemical_washer: The top tier of ore processing: 1 ore or raw ore + 100 mB of chlorine + 500 mB of water = 4 dust (one more than the Ore Purifier), in 6 seconds at 300 FE/t. Works on every ore the Ore Purifier handles, other mods' ores included. It also reprocesses Depleted Fuel Rods into Plutonium Dust. Takes Tier Installers.
jei.tieredpower.info.salt: Made by a Salt Evaporator from water. A Brine Electrolyzer turns it into chlorine for the Chemical Washer.
jei.tieredpower.info.mox_fuel_rod: Mixed-oxide fuel: uranium plus plutonium. Works in both Fission Reactors and their Fuel Ports. Each MOX rod lasts twice as long as a uranium rod and gives 50% more power - but also 50% more heat, so cool it well. It depletes into a normal Depleted Fuel Rod.
jei.tieredpower.info.plutonium_dust: Reprocess Depleted Fuel Rods in a Chemical Washer (with chlorine and water): each rod gives 1 Plutonium Dust. Smelt it into Plutonium Ingots for MOX Fuel Rods. (The Pulverizer recovers uranium dust from depleted rods instead.)
jei.tieredpower.info.quantum_suit: Powered armour, tougher than netherite. Each piece stores energy - charge it in a Charger or near a Wireless Charger. Helmet: night vision and water breathing. Chestplate: a built-in jetpack (hold jump). Leggings: speed. Boots: no fall damage and step up full blocks. Energy shield: every charged piece absorbs 22.5% of damage (90% for the full suit) at 1,000 FE per point absorbed. Each piece: its netherite version + Quantum Alloy + a Quantum Power Core (the chestplate also takes an Advanced Jetpack).
jei.tieredpower.info.smithing_press: A powered smithing table: runs smithing recipes (netherite upgrades, armour trims, other mods' smithing) - 5 seconds at 60 FE/t. Each item only goes in the slot a recipe uses it in, so pipes and Molecular Assemblers can feed it. For autocrafting, make a processing pattern from a smithing recipe (JEI's + works) and give it to an assembler touching the press.
jei.tieredpower.info.quantum_power_core: The heart of each Quantum Suit piece: 4 Quantum Alloy, 4 Superconductor Ingots and an Ultimate Battery Box.
jei.tieredpower.info.power_transmitter: Wireless power, any distance and any dimension. Feed the Power Transmitter with cables (any side). Right-click it with a Power Linker, then right-click Power Receivers to link them. Each Receiver draws power from its Transmitter and pushes it into cables and machines around it. A Transmitter hands out up to 64,000 FE/t in total, shared by its receivers. Across dimensions 10% is lost. Both ends' chunks must be loaded (a Chunk Loader helps).
jei.tieredpower.info.block_breaker: Breaks the block in front of it once a second (like a diamond pickaxe) and keeps the drops - 400 FE per block. Use its redstone setting to break only on a signal. Results go into chests, pipes or buses next to it.
jei.tieredpower.info.block_placer: Places blocks from its input slots in front of it, twice a second - 100 FE per block. Pair it with a Block Breaker for a cobblestone or stone generator.
jei.tieredpower.info.tree_farm: Plants saplings all around itself (every other block, 4 blocks out - 24 trees) on dirt or grass at its own level, and fells grown trees, keeping the logs, sticks and apples; saplings go back into its sapling slots. Fertilizer (32 growth steps) or bone meal (8) in its fertilizer slot grows the saplings, even in the dark. Restocks Fertilizer and saplings from an adjacent storage network. 200 FE per job.
jei.tieredpower.info.animal_ranch: Looks after animals on a 9x9 area in front of it: breeds pairs with feed from its inputs (up to 24 animals), shears sheep, milks cows into empty buckets, and picks up eggs and feathers. 200 FE per job.
jei.tieredpower.info.storage_monitor: Connect it to your storage network and right-click it with an item: its screen shows that item and how many the network holds, live. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to clear it. A comparator reads the stock (0 when there are none, +1 per doubling: 1, 2, 4 ... 16,384+ = 15) - follow it with a redstone torch for a low-stock alarm.
jei.tieredpower.info.matrix_controller: The Assembly Matrix: a box from 3x3x3 to 7x7x7 of Matrix Casing (or Matrix Glass) with this controller in a wall, joined to your storage network. Swap wall blocks for Pattern Banks (27 patterns each) and Crafting Accelerators - they can also go inside. Right-click the controller to store patterns, a bank per page. Crafting patterns are made inside the Matrix (2 per cycle, +2 per accelerator). Processing patterns run on any machine of the right type with a Molecular Assembler or Machine Connector on it - set each pattern's Machine in the Pattern Encoder.
jei.tieredpower.info.machine_connector: A flat panel that joins the machine it's stuck on to the storage network, so the Assembly Matrix can use it - like a Molecular Assembler without pattern slots. Sneak + right-click to place it on a machine's face, then connect Storage Cable to it. Runs up to 4 operations per cycle.
jei.tieredpower.info.assembler_panel: A flat Molecular Assembler - the same 9 pattern slots, screen and upgrades. Sneak + right-click to stick it onto a machine's face, then connect Storage Cable to it. Crafted from a Molecular Assembler (and back again).
jei.tieredpower.info.plasma_coil: Right-click a Fusion Reactor or Fusion Controller to raise its plasma tier, in order: Mk I = x2 output, Mk II = x3, Mk III = x4. Fuel burns x1.5 / x2 / x2.5 as fast, so every tier gets more power from each fuel pair - pipe in deuterium and tritium gas to keep up. The coils drop back out if the reactor is broken.
jei.tieredpower.info.particle_collider: Makes antimatter: each operation turns 10 mB deuterium + 10 mB tritium + 20,000 FE into 1 mB of antimatter, one per tick (more with Speed Upgrades). Pipe the gases in and power it from below; antimatter goes out into Gas Pipes or an Antimatter Reactor next to it.
jei.tieredpower.info.antimatter_reactor: The end-game generator: burns antimatter for 50,000 FE per mB, up to 20 mB a tick (1,000,000 FE/t). Holds 50,000,000 FE and pushes power out of every side. That's 2.5x the power the Particle Collider spent making it.
jei.tieredpower.info.fluid_filter: Filters a fluid or gas pipe connection. Right-click in the air to set it up: click its 9 slots with a bucket or tank of each fluid, and choose Allow or Block. Then right-click a pipe connection (where it meets a machine or tank) to install it; sneak + right-click the connection with an empty hand to take it off.
jei.tieredpower.info.quantum_drill: A drill, shovel, axe and hoe in one - very fast, and it mines a 1x1, 3x3, 5x5 or 7x7 area on the face you look at (shift + right-click to switch). 50,000,000 FE, 400 FE per block. Charge it in a Charger or near a Wireless Charger.
jei.tieredpower.info.wireless_transport: Wireless item and fluid transport, any distance, any dimension. Pipes, hoppers or buses fill a Wireless Sender (9 item slots, 16,000 mB tank). Right-click it with a Wireless Linker, then right-click Wireless Receivers to link them. Each Receiver takes up to 32 items and 2,000 mB twice a second and pushes them into the inventories and tanks next to it. Both ends' chunks must be loaded.
jei.tieredpower.info.buffer: A queue between machines: takes items (Item Buffer, 27 slots) or fluid (Fluid Buffer, 32,000 mB) in from any side except the front, and pushes them out of the front - 16 items every 4 ticks or 1,000 mB a tick. The front faces the way you look when you place it.
jei.tieredpower.info.suit_module: A Quantum Suit module. Wear the right piece (Magnet and Flight: chestplate; Auto-Feed: helmet; Jump Boost: leggings; Water Walking: boots) and right-click the module to fit it. Press the Suit Modules key (V by default) to switch modules on or off or take them out. Modules run on the suit's charge.
jei.tieredpower.info.launch_site: The launch site: a 3x3 of Launch Pads with a Launch Tower beside it and a Launch Controller touching the pad. Put a Rocket and a Solar Satellite in the controller, pipe in 16,000 mB of Rocket Fuel, make sure nothing is above the pad, and press LAUNCH. After a 10 second countdown the rocket lifts off and the satellite reaches orbit.
jei.tieredpower.info.receiver_dish: Right-click to claim one of your Solar Satellites in orbit: it then makes about 100,000 FE/t, day and night, and pushes power out of every side. Sneak + right-click to release the satellite (for another dish).
jei.tieredpower.info.laser_drill: The Orbital Mining Laser. Launch a Mining Satellite from a Launch Pad, then place a Laser Drill under open sky: it claims one of your free Mining Satellites and, while powered (2,000,000 FE per ore, about 100,000 FE/t), the satellite's laser drills one ore a second out of the ground beneath it - any ore in the forge:ores tag, including other mods'. Laser Lenses in its input slots make their ore ten times as likely; several lenses stack.
jei.tieredpower.info.radiation: Radiation is optional - switch it on in the config ([radiation] enabled = true). Running fission reactors within 16 blocks, and carrying depleted fuel rods, plutonium, MOX or uranium, give you a radiation dose that slowly fades once you're clear. A high dose brings nausea, then weakness and hunger, then poison, then damage. Each Hazmat piece blocks 25% (a full suit blocks it all); the Quantum Suit's Radiation Shielding module blocks it all. Hold a Geiger Counter to measure it; Iodine Tablets remove 300 rad.
jei.tieredpower.info.brewing_machine: An electric brewing stand for automation: put glass bottles (or water bottles / potions) in its 3 bottle slots and an ingredient on top. It fills glass bottles with water from its tank (pipe water in or use a bucket), then brews all three with one ingredient in 5 seconds at 20 FE/t - no blaze powder. Every vanilla potion works, and modded brewing too. Potions come out of the bottom. JEI's + on a brewing recipe makes a 3-bottle pattern for it.
jei.tieredpower.info.fluidic_plenisher: Pipe a fluid in (or pour a bucket) and power it: it fills the space below and around it with source blocks - one every half second, 1,000 mB and 100 FE each - spreading outwards and downwards up to 32 blocks, never above itself. Good for moats, filling holes, or lava for a lava farm.
jei.tieredpower.info.block_mover: Right-click a chest, machine or tank to pick it up with everything inside, then right-click a surface to put it down somewhere else, contents intact. Respects storage network security.
jei.tieredpower.info.ore_scanner: Right-click to list the ores within 16 blocks: how many of each, and the direction and distance to the nearest one. 5,000 FE per scan; charge it in a Charger.
jei.tieredpower.info.greenhouse: The greenhouse: a Crop Farmer plants and harvests; Sprinklers (fed water by pipe or bucket, 20 mB a second) hung above the crops keep the farmland wet and speed growth; Grow Lamps (40 FE/t) give full light so crops grow indoors and at night, and speed them up too. Both cover a 9x9 area up to 6 blocks below. Fertilizer is three bone meal in one - put it in the Crop Farmer's seed slots and it fertilises unripe crops for you. Greenhouse Glass is for the walls and roof.
jei.tieredpower.info.digital_miner: A quarry that only takes what you ask for. Put Item Filters in its slots to choose the ores (none = every ore), and an Enchanted Book of Silk Touch or Fortune to set how they're mined - the book isn't used up. It scans a 33x33 area under itself layer by layer, from just below it down to the bottom of the world, mining only the wanted ores (800 FE each, up to 4 a second) and leaving the rest alone. Changing the filters or book starts the scan again from the top. Keep the area's chunks loaded (a Chunk Loader helps).
jei.tieredpower.info.coke_oven: No power needed. Bakes coal into Coal Coke (burns twice as long as coal, and makes steel in the Industrial Blast Furnace) plus 250 mB of Creosote Oil, in 30 seconds; logs become charcoal plus 125 mB of Creosote. Take the Creosote out with pipes or a bucket - it makes Treated Planks.
jei.tieredpower.info.industrial_blast_fu: No power needed. Turns an iron ingot and a Coal Coke into a steel ingot in 20 seconds - steel before you have any power.
jei.tieredpower.info.gas_containers: Gas containers. A Gas Cylinder holds 8,000 mB of one gas - right-click a machine, tank or Gas Tank to fill it from there or empty it in; its shoulder shows the gas's colour. A Gas Tank holds 64,000 mB of one gas, connects to Gas Pipes on any side, and keeps its gas when you break it.
jei.tieredpower.info.bio_refinery: Turns crops into Biodiesel: seeds are pressed into plant oil (50 mB each, sunflowers 200), and sugary crops (sugar, sugar cane, wheat, potatoes, carrots, beetroot, apples, berries, melon, pumpkins, honey) are fermented into ethanol. The two blend 1:1 into Biodiesel, which comes out into Fluid Pipes. 20 FE/t.
jei.tieredpower.info.diesel_generator: Burns liquid fuel, 1 mB a tick: Biodiesel 200 FE/t, Rocket Fuel 300 FE/t, Creosote Oil 40 FE/t. Pipe it in or pour a bucket in; power comes out of every side.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.coal_generator: Your first power source - smoke rises from its chimney while it burns. Burns any furnace fuel - coal, charcoal, planks, sawdust, other mods' fuels - and pushes power into cables and machines on every side.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.bio_refinery: Turns your crops into fuel. Seeds are pressed into plant oil (50 mB each - a sunflower gives 200), and sugary crops are fermented into ethanol: sugar 100 mB, sugar cane and pumpkins 80, apples 60, wheat and potatoes 50, carrots and beetroot 40, berries 30, melon slices 25, a honey bottle 150. It blends the two half and half into Biodiesel and pushes it out into Fluid Pipes (or take it with a bucket). 20 FE/t while working. Feed it both kinds of crop - from a greenhouse, say - and it never stops.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.diesel_generato: Burns liquid fuel for power, 1 mB a tick: Biodiesel gives 200 FE/t, Rocket Fuel 300 FE/t, and Creosote Oil from the Coke Oven 40 FE/t - so even the early game's by-product makes power. Pipe the fuel in or pour a bucket in; it holds 200,000 FE, pushes power out of every side, and idles while full. Its grille glows while it runs.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.boiler: Boils water into steam for Steam Turbines. Heat comes from any furnace fuel or lava in its tank (full speed), or free from lava, magma, fire or a lit campfire directly underneath (half speed). Water comes from a Sink, Pump, pipes, tanks or buckets. Steam goes straight into a turbine on top, or out through Gas Pipes on any side to turbines anywhere.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.steam_turbine: Turns steam into power. Place it on top of a Boiler, or feed it steam through Gas Pipes. It spins up over about 5 seconds and outputs power on every side except the bottom.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.electrolyzer: Makes fusion fuel. Empty Fuel Cell + water gives a Deuterium Cell; Empty Fuel Cell + Lithium Ingot gives a Tritium Cell. Pulls water from anything next to it.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fusion_reactor: The compact, single-block reactor. Charge it with 1,000,000 FE, load a Deuterium and a Tritium cell and it ignites. Each pair burns for 2 minutes. If fuel runs out it cools over about 25 seconds - refuel in time or it needs re-igniting. Also the core ingredient of the multiblock Fusion Controller. It also runs on gas: pipe in deuterium (from an Isotope Separator) and tritium (from a Tritium Breeder) - 250 mB of each lasts as long as one pair of cells, and gas is burned before cells. Plasma Coils (Mk I-III) raise its output up to x4.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.solar_panel: Free power in daylight (20 FE/t in full sun) when nothing blocks its view of the sky. Half power in rain, nothing at night. A low panel you can walk on; pushes power down and sideways into cables.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.advanced_solar_: Made from 4 Solar Panels. Makes 100 FE/t in full sun.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.elite_solar_pan: Made from 4 Advanced Solar Panels. Makes 450 FE/t in full sun.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.ultimate_solar_: Made from 4 Elite Solar Panels. Makes 2,000 FE/t in full sun.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.quantum_solar_p: Tier 5 solar: made from 4 Ultimate Solar Panels, Quantum Alloy and Quantum Cable. Makes 9,000 FE/t in full sun.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.lightning_colle: Banks the power of thunderstorms. Put a vanilla Lightning Rod on top of it (or on one of its sides). During a thunderstorm the rod pulls in lightning from up to 128 blocks away, and every strike that hits it adds 2,500,000 FE to the collector in one go. It stores 25 million FE and feeds it out steadily at up to 20,000 FE/t on every side - one good storm can run a base for days. It glows for a few seconds after a strike, a comparator next to it reads how full it is, and the Multimeter shows how many strikes it has caught. A strike straight onto the collector counts too.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.power_transmitt: Wireless power - any distance, any dimension, no cable runs. Feed a Power Transmitter with cables on any side. Right-click it with a Wireless Linker, then right-click as many Power Receivers as you like to link them to it. Each Receiver draws power from its Transmitter and pushes it into the cables, machines and batteries around it. A Transmitter hands out up to 64,000 FE/t in total, shared between its receivers; each holds 1,000,000 FE as a buffer. Links within a dimension are lossless; across dimensions (power your Nether outpost from the Overworld) 10% is lost on the way. The chunks at both ends must be loaded - a Chunk Loader at each end makes it reliable. Jade shows what each end is doing.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.gas_tank: Containers for gases. The Gas Tank is a tall pressure cylinder holding 64,000 mB of one gas: connect Gas Pipes to any side to fill it or draw from it, and break it to carry the gas away - it keeps its contents (shown on the item). Right-click it to see what's inside. The Gas Cylinder is the handheld version, like a real oxygen bottle: it holds 8,000 mB of one gas, and its coloured shoulder shows which. Right-click any machine, tank or Gas Tank with it to fill the cylinder from there - or, if it's full, to empty it in. Gases only; liquids use buckets and Fluid Tanks. The creative tab has a full cylinder of every gas for testing.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.wireless_sender: Wireless item and fluid transport - any distance, any dimension. Feed a Wireless Sender with pipes, hoppers or buses: it holds 9 stacks of items and 16,000 mB of one fluid or gas. Right-click it with a Wireless Linker, then right-click as many Wireless Receivers as you like. Each Receiver takes up to 32 items and 2,000 mB from its Sender twice a second and pushes them straight into the chests, machines, tanks and pipes next to it. Ship ore home from a remote quarry, send fuel to an outpost, or move gas between dimensions. The chunks at both ends must be loaded (a Chunk Loader helps); Jade shows each end's state.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.wireless_receiv: The other end of a Wireless Sender: link it with a Wireless Linker (right-click the Sender first). It pulls items and fluid from its Sender and pushes them into everything next to it.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.item_buffer: A queue between machines. It takes items in from any side except its front (27 slots) and steadily pushes them out of the front - 16 items every 4 ticks - into a pipe, machine or chest. Put one between a fast producer and a slow machine so the producer never stalls. The front (with the arrow) faces the way you look when you place it.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fluid_buffer: The fluid version of the Item Buffer: holds 32,000 mB of one fluid or gas, filled from any side except the front, and pushes 1,000 mB a tick out of the front.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.storm_caller: Calls a thunderstorm when you want one. Once it holds 4,000,000 FE and has a Storm Charge in its slot, it uses both to start a 5-minute storm - only in dimensions with weather, and never while it's already storming, so charges aren't wasted. It follows its redstone setting: on Always it storms as soon as it can; set it to need a signal and use a lever, or a comparator on a Lightning Collector, to call storms only when the collectors run low. Takes power through the bottom like other machines.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.storm_charge: Fuel for the Storm Caller - one per storm. Made from a ghast tear, copper and redstone.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.geothermal_gene: Free power from heat, no fuel needed. Every lava SOURCE block touching it - on any of its six sides - gives 20 FE/t (up to 120 FE/t), and every magma block 5 FE/t. Build it into a lava lake, or surround it with placed lava. Flowing lava doesn't count.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.water_wheel: Cheap, always-on power from moving water. Every side (north, south, east, west) with FLOWING water next to it gives 8 FE/t, up to 32 FE/t; still water doesn't turn it. Its paddles spin while it works. Great for a river base or a little stream from a water source.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.wind_turbine: A big three-blade rotor that spins while it makes power. The higher you build it, the more it makes: nothing at sea level (Y 64), rising to full power (128 FE/t) at Y 256. Rain gives x1.5 and thunderstorms x2. Blocks within 3 blocks of it slow it down, so put it on a hill or tower with open space. Its GUI shows height, weather and how open the space is.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fission_reactor: The compact, single-block fission generator - and the core ingredient of the Fission Controller for the multiblock reactor. Burns up to 4 Uranium Fuel Rods (5 minutes each; they come back as Depleted Fuel Rods). Output rises with heat and is full at 50%. Above that it cools itself with water from a Sink, Pump or pipes - and the water flashes to steam, which it pushes into Gas Pipes or Steam Turbines for bonus power. Without water it overheats and SCRAMs (shuts itself down until cool). Meltdown explosions are off unless you turn them on in the config. Two add-ons work with it: a Tritium Breeder next to it turns lithium into tritium for fusion, and a Cryo Injector fed with nitrogen gives +50% power. It burns MOX Fuel Rods too: twice as long, 50% more power and heat.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fusion_controll: Brain of the multiblock Fusion Reactor. Build a hollow box (any size from 3x3x3 to 13x13x13), put the controller into a side wall facing out, fill the inside with Magnet Coils and right-click the controller. If something's wrong it names the exact block and position. Gas works here too: pipe deuterium and tritium into the controller - 250 mB of each per fuel pair, burned before cells. Plasma Coils (Mk I-III) raise its output up to x4, and a Reactor Gauge can be built into its walls.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.reactor_casing: The frame of the Fusion Reactor. Every edge and corner must be casing; the flat walls can also be glass or ports.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.reactor_glass: See-through wall block for the Fusion Reactor, so you can watch the coils glow. Walls only - not edges or corners.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.magnet_coil: Fills the inside of the Fusion Reactor. Each coil adds 1,500 FE/t to the reactor's output. Coils light up and ripple with plasma while the reactor runs.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.reactor_fuel_po: Wall block of the Fusion Reactor. Hoppers, pipes and machines put Deuterium and Tritium cells in here and take the empty cells out. You need at least one.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.reactor_power_p: Wall block of the Fusion Reactor. Feed ignition power in here while the reactor is off; once running it pushes power out into cables. Big reactors need several ports and Netherite Cable.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fission_control: Brain of the multiblock Fission Reactor. Build a hollow box (3x3x3 to 13x13x13) of Fission Casing, put the controller in a side wall facing out, and put at least one Fuel Assembly inside. Once it forms, water from the Coolant Port floods the empty space around the rods - you can watch them glowing underwater through the glass. Feed fuel rods through a Fuel Port (or the controller's GUI, which stores up to 64). The ports only work once the reactor has formed - right-click the controller to check. MOX Fuel Rods work here too (burned first): twice as long, 50% more power and heat.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fission_casing: Frame of the multiblock Fission Reactor. Edges and corners must be casing. Green hazard stripes.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fission_glass: See-through wall block for the Fission Reactor - watch the fuel glow.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fuel_assembly: Goes inside the Fission Reactor. Makes up to 1,000 FE/t at full heat and adds 1 heat per tick. Every other assembly touching it adds +10% efficiency. One fuel rod lasts 6,000 assembly-ticks, so 10 assemblies use a rod every 30 seconds. Glows and pulses while the reactor runs.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.coolant_channel: Optional, inside the Fission Reactor. Each channel removes 10 heat per tick - five times what a water block does - so it's the compact way to cool a large core.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fission_fuel_po: Wall block: fuel rods go IN. Right-click it holding rods to load them, or feed it with hoppers and Item Pipes. Right-click with an empty hand to see how many rods are loaded (up to 64).
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fission_waste_p: Optional wall block: pushes depleted rods OUT into an Item Pipe, chest or hopper next to it. Pipe them to a Pulverizer to get uranium back for new rods. Without one, depleted rods wait in the controller's output slot.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fission_coolant: Wall block: water in (Sink, Pump, Fluid Pipes) - it first floods the inside of the reactor - and steam out into Gas Pipes or Steam Turbines beside it.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fission_power_p: Wall block: pushes the reactor's power into cables.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.battery_box: Stores power. The face pointing at you when placed is the Input; the other five faces are Outputs. Shift + right-click a face with an empty hand (or right-click with the Wrench) to cycle it Input / Output / Disabled. Keeps its energy when mined. Comparators read how full it is.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.advanced_batter: Bigger, faster Battery Box. Same face controls. Crafting it from a Battery Box doesn't carry the energy over - drain it first.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.quantum_battery: Tier 5: the largest single-block battery, holding two billion FE.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.bank_controller: Brain of the Energy Bank - multiblock storage built like the Fusion Reactor. Any box from 3x3x3 to 13x13x13, controller in a side wall, Energy Cells inside. The GUI shows stored energy, capacity and live in/out rates. Breaking the structure keeps the energy; nothing flows until it's rebuilt.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.bank_casing: Frame of the Energy Bank. Edges and corners must be casing. Yellow hazard stripes so it's easy to tell from reactor casing.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.bank_glass: See-through wall block for the Energy Bank.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.bank_port: Wall block of the Energy Bank. Input (blue arrow) accepts power; Output (orange arrow) pushes power into cables. Shift + right-click with an empty hand, or use the Wrench, to switch. Add more ports for more throughput.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.energy_cell: Goes inside the Energy Bank. Tiers can be mixed.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.quantum_energy_: Tier 5 cell for the Energy Bank - eight times an Ultimate cell. Made from 4 Ultimate Energy Cells.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.copper_cable: Carries Forge Energy - works with any mod that uses FE (Mekanism, Thermal, Powah, AE2...). All connected cables act as one network and share power fairly, however long the run. Each connection to a machine is limited by the cable tier touching it; tiers can be mixed. Cables are see-through: a glowing yellow line runs through them while power is flowing, and goes dark when the line is idle.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.gold_cable: Mid-tier cable. Cables are see-through: a glowing yellow line runs through them while power is flowing, and goes dark when the line is idle.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.diamond_cable: High-tier cable. Cables are see-through: a glowing yellow line runs through them while power is flowing, and goes dark when the line is idle.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.netherite_cable: Top-tier cable, for fusion reactors and Energy Banks. Cables are see-through: a glowing yellow line runs through them while power is flowing, and goes dark when the line is idle.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.quantum_cable: Tier 5 cable: 2,048,000 FE/t per connection, sixteen times Netherite. For full-size fusion reactors, Quantum Battery Boxes and big Energy Banks. Made from 8 Netherite Cable around a Quantum Alloy Ingot. Cables are see-through: a glowing yellow line runs through them while power is flowing, and goes dark when the line is idle.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.basic_fluid_pip: Carries liquids (water, lava, other mods' liquids). Connected pipes form one network carrying one fluid at a time. Pipes push into the tanks and machines they touch; Wrench a connection to cycle Push / Pull (orange ring) / Push + Pull / Disabled.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.basic_gas_pipe: Carries gases - fluids lighter than air, such as Steam. Use it to pipe steam from Boilers to Steam Turbines anywhere. Doesn't connect to liquid pipes. (Mekanism's gases use their own system and need Mekanism's tubes.)
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.quantum_gas_pip: Tier 5 gas pipe - enough for a large reactor's steam.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.basic_item_pipe: Moves items between inventories - chests, machines, Storage Drawers, AE2 ME Interfaces, Refined Storage Interfaces, Sophisticated Storage. Items pushed in (by a machine's auto-output or a hopper) are delivered to the other inventories on the network, never back into the sender, and you can watch them glide along the pipes. Wrench a connection to cycle Push / Pull / Push + Pull / Disabled - a Pull only moves items when another connection on the network is set to Push. Right-click a connection with an empty hand to set its priority (0-9): higher priorities fill first, equal ones share.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.item_filter: Right-click the air to set up to 9 items, choose Allow or Block, and choose how to match: Item (exactly those items), Tag (anything sharing a tag - one raw ore matches all raw ores, one log matches all logs) or Mod (anything from the same mod). Right-click an Item Pipe connection with it to install it; shift + right-click the connection with an empty hand to take it off. A delivering connection then only accepts matching items; a pulling connection only pulls them. Its Name mode matches items whose id starts with the same word as the filter item - a deepslate iron ore matches every deepslate_... item.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fluid_filter: Picks which fluids and gases a pipe connection lets through. Right-click it in the air to set it up: click its 9 slots with a bucket or tank of each fluid, and choose Allow (only these) or Block (everything but these). Then right-click a fluid or gas pipe where it connects to a machine or tank to install it, and sneak + right-click there with an empty hand to take it off. On a Pull connection it chooses what's pulled out - handy for taking just the hydrogen out of an electrolyzer that holds several gases; on a Push connection it chooses what's delivered. Filters drop out if the pipe is broken.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.quantum_drill: The ultimate mining tool: a drill, shovel, axe and hoe in one, mining very fast and digging a 1x1, 3x3, 5x5 or 7x7 area on whichever face you look at - shift + right-click to switch. It stores 50,000,000 FE and uses 400 FE per block, so a full charge lasts for well over a hundred thousand blocks. Charge it in a Charger or near a Wireless Charger. Made from an Advanced Drill, Quantum Alloy and a Quantum Power Core.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.coke_oven: Early-game heavy industry - no power needed, the coal heats itself. Put coal in and it bakes into Coal Coke in 30 seconds, giving off 250 mB of Creosote Oil; logs become charcoal plus 125 mB of Creosote in 15 seconds. Coal Coke burns twice as long as coal in any furnace or generator, and turns iron into steel in the Industrial Blast Furnace. Take the Creosote Oil out with a pipe or an empty bucket; eight planks around a Creosote Oil Bucket make 8 Treated Planks. The front glows while it's working.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.industrial_blas: Steel before you have any power: an iron ingot and a Coal Coke (from a Coke Oven) become a steel ingot in 20 seconds - no fuel or power needed. Feed iron and coke in from the top or sides; steel comes out of the bottom.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.electric_furnac: Smelts anything a furnace can, using power instead of fuel.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.pulverizer: Grinds ores and raw ores into 2 dusts - ore doubling. Smelt the dusts into ingots.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.alloy_smelter: Combines two inputs into an alloy. Inputs can go in either slot. With pipes or buses, feed both ingredients in through In faces - from the same pipe or different ones: each ingredient goes into its own slot, and items that don't make a recipe with what's loaded are refused, so it can't jam.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.ore_purifier: Washes ores and raw ores with water into 3 dusts - ore tripling. Put a Sink next to it for endless water.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.chemical_washer: The top tier of ore processing. Chlorine dissolves the metal out of an ore, giving 4 dust per ore or raw ore - one more than the Ore Purifier and double the Pulverizer. Each ore takes 100 mB of chlorine and 500 mB of water, 6 seconds at 300 FE/t. It works on every ore the Ore Purifier handles, including other mods' ores and raw ores. Takes Speed and Energy upgrades and Tier Installers, so a Quantum Chemical Washer handles 9 ores at a time. The chain: water -> Salt Evaporator -> salt -> Brine Electrolyzer -> chlorine (and hydrogen) -> Chemical Washer. It also reprocesses Depleted Fuel Rods into Plutonium Dust for MOX fuel.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.brine_electroly: Makes chlorine for the Chemical Washer by passing current through salt water: each salt plus 500 mB of water becomes 250 mB of chlorine and 250 mB of hydrogen, in 2 seconds at 200 FE/t. It pushes both gases out into Gas Pipes - send the chlorine to your washers and burn the hydrogen in a Gas Burner Generator to win some power back.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.salt_evaporator: Boils water down to salt: 1,000 mB of water makes 1 salt in 5 seconds at 40 FE/t. Give it water from a Sink, an Electric Pump or pipes, and take the salt out with a pipe, a bus or auto-output. One evaporator keeps a Brine Electrolyzer busy about two-fifths of the time.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.salt: Salt from a Salt Evaporator. A Brine Electrolyzer turns it into chlorine. Tagged forge:dusts/salt, so other mods' salt works too.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.compressor: Presses items: ingots into plates, 8 coal blocks into a diamond, and more.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.electric_sawmil: Cuts logs into 6 planks plus sawdust (crafting only gives 4), and planks into sticks.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.rock_crusher: Crushes the blocks you put in: stone down to gravel and sand, and any ore block - normal or deepslate - into raw materials (2 raw iron, gold, uranium or lithium, 5 raw copper) or its gems, redstone, lapis, coal, quartz or netherite scrap.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.freezer: Compresses 9 Ice into Packed Ice and 9 Packed Ice into Blue Ice. With nothing to compress it freezes its tank: 1,000 mB water gives Ice, 1,000 mB lava gives Obsidian. Pulls water or lava from neighbours. Takes Tier Installers: 3, 5, 7, 9 or 12 at once (Advanced to Naquadah).
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.charger: Charges any Forge Energy item from any mod - tools, armour, jetpacks, batteries. Fully charged items move to the output slot so a hopper can collect them. In autocrafting it can charge items as a step: make a charging pattern (the item as input, the same item as output, then press the Charge button in the Pattern Encoder) and give it to a Molecular Assembler touching the Charger. The item goes in, comes back fully charged and the craft carries on.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.sink: Endless water. Pushes water into any tank, pipe or machine next to it and fills buckets. Needs no water source and no power.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.electric_pump: Place it above a lake or lava pool - it looks straight down through air to find the fluid. Pumps from anywhere in the connected fluid within 32 blocks. Water is left in place (it never runs out); lava and other fluids are removed. Pushes what it pumps into tanks, pipes or machines beside or above it. Upgradable: Speed and Energy upgrades as usual, and Tier Installers make it pump 3, 5, 7, 9 or 12 buckets per cycle (Advanced to Naquadah), with a tank that grows to match (up to 192,000 mB), a reach of up to 128 blocks and faster output.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.basic_fluid_tan: Holds one fluid. The fluid level shows through the glass (lava glows). Buckets and pipes work on any side; keeps its contents when mined; comparators read how full it is. Right-click with an empty hand to see what's inside.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.quarry: Mines an area layer by layer. Settings in its GUI: area size (3x3 to 65x65), centred on the quarry or behind it, how deep to dig (shift-click for 10 at a time), and tool mode - Normal, Silk Touch or Fortune III (50% more power). Items in the Void slots are thrown away. Skips fluids, unbreakable blocks and anything with an inventory, so it never destroys chests or spawners. Items go to its buffer and are pushed into neighbouring chests or pipes. To choose exactly where it digs, use a Quarry Planner. It sends what it mines out through the faces set to Out in its Sides window - pipes, chests, or an Import Bus.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.digital_miner: A quarry that only takes what you ask for. Tell it which ores to find with Item Filters in its slots - for example one set to Allow and Tag mode holding a diamond ore takes every diamond ore, deepslate ones included; with no filter it takes every ore. Put an Enchanted Book of Silk Touch, or of Fortune I to III, in a slot to choose how they're mined - the book is a setting and isn't used up. It scans a 33x33 area under itself layer by layer, from just below the machine down to the bottom of the world, and mines only the wanted ores - up to 4 a second at 800 FE each - leaving the stone and everything else exactly where it was. Ores go into its output grid and out to chests, pipes or buses next to it. Change the filters or the book and it starts scanning again from the top. Jade shows how many ores it has mined and which layer it's on. Keep the area loaded with a Chunk Loader. It's built like a proper drilling rig - a base plate, corner struts, a radar screen and an antenna, with its drill going into the ground.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.crop_farmer: Tends a 9x9 area around itself at its own height. Harvests and replants ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot and nether wart; harvests melons and pumpkins; cuts sugar cane and cactus, leaving the bottom block to regrow. Its three seed slots plant empty spots on its own level: crop seeds on farmland, nether wart on soul sand, melon and pumpkin seeds on farmland, cactus on sand, and Sugar Cane Seeds (or sugar cane) on sand, dirt or grass that has water right beside it - or on Irrigated Sand under a Sprinkler, with no water channel needed. Like crops, they sit on the ground one block below the farmer's level. Fertilizer or bone meal goes in the slot on the far left. The farmer grows each plant that is still growing by one step as it passes; one Fertilizer is good for 32 steps and bone meal for 8, so a stack of Fertilizer lasts a long time. Put it next to a storage cable and it restocks itself from your storage network: Fertilizer (or bone meal) and more of the seeds already in its slots. Harvest is pushed into neighbouring chests.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.sprinkler: Part of the greenhouse system. Hang Sprinklers from the ceiling (or put one on top of a post) above your crops and pipe water in, or right-click with a water bucket: each uses 20 mB of water a second, keeps every farmland block in a 9x9 area up to 6 blocks below it wet, and gives the plants a 15% chance of an extra growth step every second - with a little shower of water. Pair it with a Grow Lamp for even faster growth, and a Crop Farmer to plant and harvest.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.grow_lamp: A powered lamp for the greenhouse: hang it above the crops and connect power (40 FE/t). It gives full light, so crops grow indoors, underground and at night, and gives plants in a 9x9 area up to 6 blocks below a 10% chance of an extra growth step every second. Its bulb glows while it has power.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fertilizer: Three bone meal in one (2 bone meal + rotten flesh + dirt makes 4). Right-click a plant to grow it a lot, or put it in a Crop Farmer's fertilizer slot: it then fertilises everything still growing as it passes - crops, melon and pumpkin stems, sugar cane, cactus and nether wart - one growth step each, 32 steps per Fertilizer. With Sprinklers and Grow Lamps overhead, a greenhouse turns out crops very quickly - feed the surplus to a Bio-Digester for methane.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.greenhouse_glas: Green-framed glass for building the greenhouse's walls and roof (8 from glass and green dye).
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.auto_crafter: Crafts one recipe over and over. Click items into its 3x3 pattern to set the recipe - they're ghost items and aren't used up. Ingredients are pulled from chests next to it; leftovers like empty buckets go back into a neighbouring inventory.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.chunk_loader: Keeps a square of chunks around it loaded while powered, so your reactor, quarry and farms run while you're away. Click the size button for a bigger area, right-click it for a smaller one: up to 5x5 chunks, or 7x7, 9x9, 11x11, 15x15 and 19x19 with Advanced, Elite, Ultimate, Quantum and Naquadah Tier Installers. Costs power per chunk loaded. Releases the chunks when it runs out of power, is switched off with redstone, or is broken.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.enchanting_mach: Enchants with power instead of your XP. Put an enchantable item (or a book) in the left slot and lapis in the middle, then pick level 10, 20 or 30 with the button. Books come out as enchanted books.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.mob_grinder: Attacks mobs in a 5x3x5 area in front of it, as if a player hit them - so they drop player-only loot and XP. Drops go into its buffer (auto-output and pipes work); XP is stored - click the XP button in its GUI to take it. Choose hostile only or all mobs. It never harms players, bosses, name-tagged mobs, tamed pets or armour stands.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.spawner_control: Place it touching a vanilla mob spawner. While powered, the spawner works without a player nearby and spawns faster and more mobs at a time (Speed Upgrades push it further). Without power it goes back to normal. Put a Mob Grinder in front of the spawner for a complete mob farm.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.fluid_mixer: Mixes fluids with items: concrete powder + water gives concrete (any colour), dirt + water gives mud, and with the slot empty, lava + water gives obsidian. Pulls water and lava from a Sink, Pump, pipes or tanks.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.teleporter: Right-click a pad with an empty hand to give it a name and pick where it sends you - every pad in the world is listed, even in other dimensions. Then stand on the pad and crouch to travel. Uses power from the pad you leave from.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.condenser: Turns steam back into water (10 mB of steam makes 1 mB of water), up to 1,000 mB of steam per tick, with no power. Takes steam from Gas Pipes, Boilers or reactors next to it and pushes the water into anything that takes water - put it next to a Fission Reactor's Coolant Port for a closed water loop.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.teleporter_link: A shortcut: right-click one Teleporter pad, then another, and they're linked both ways. (You can also pick destinations from a pad's own screen.)
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.gas_electrolyze: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen using power. Pulls water from a Sink, Electric Pump or pipes and pushes both gases out into Gas Pipes, Fluid Tanks or a Gas Burner Generator. Put a Hydrogen Jetpack in its slot to refuel it. Speed and Efficiency Upgrades work here.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.gas_burner_gene: Burns gas for power, up to 40 mB per tick. Hydrogen gives 7 FE per mB (9 with half as much oxygen); methane from a Bio-Digester gives 12 FE per mB (15 with the same amount of oxygen). Hydrogen is burned first if both are piped in. Making hydrogen costs more power than burning it gives back, so think of hydrogen as a way to store and move energy - methane, on the other hand, is free fuel from farm waste. Idles when full, so no gas is wasted.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.steam_engine: A cheap, early steam generator with no spin-up. Put it next to a Boiler, a Fission Reactor or a Gas Pipe carrying steam. The Steam Turbine gets twice as much out of the same steam, so this is the step before it.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.steam_hammer: Runs Pulverizer recipes (ore doubling, gravel, sand and more) on steam instead of power. A good use for spare Boiler or reactor steam. Speed Upgrades make it faster and use more steam.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.hydrogen_jetpac: Flies like the Advanced Jetpack but burns hydrogen instead of FE, and a full tank lasts a long time. Refuel it by putting it in a Gas Electrolyzer's slot (a Charger won't fill it).
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.quantum_chestpl: Powered armour for the end game - tougher than netherite, and it never wears out because it runs on energy. Each piece stores its own charge: put it in a Charger, or just stand near a Wireless Charger while wearing it. Helmet: night vision and water breathing (20 FE/t). Chestplate: the fastest jetpack in the mod - hold jump to fly (120 FE/t while thrusting). Leggings: a speed boost (10 FE/t). Boots: no fall damage, and you step up full blocks without jumping. Energy shield: every charged piece absorbs 22.5% of the damage you take - 90% with the full suit - at 1,000 FE per point of damage absorbed. When a piece runs dry it's still strong armour, just without its powers. Each piece is made from its netherite version, Quantum Alloy and a Quantum Power Core; the chestplate also needs an Advanced Jetpack. The whole suit can be autocrafted: the netherite pieces through a Smithing Press, the rest through crafting and Alloy Smelter patterns.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.quantum_power_c: The heart of each Quantum Suit piece: 4 Quantum Alloy, 4 Superconductor Ingots and an Ultimate Battery Box (a charged one is fine).
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.magnet_module: Quantum Suit modules add powers to the suit. Wear the right piece and right-click a module to fit it; press the Suit Modules key (V by default) to switch each one on or off or take it out again (you get the module back). They run on the charge of the piece they're in. Magnet (chestplate): pulls dropped items and XP orbs to you from 8 blocks away - hold sneak to pause it. Flight (chestplate): creative-style flight while charged - double-tap jump; 100 FE/t while flying. Auto-Feed (helmet): eats the most filling safe food in your inventory whenever you're hungry. Jump Boost (leggings): jump about three blocks high. Water Walking (boots): walk on water; sneak to go under. Each is made from Quantum Alloy, superconductor, a redstone block and one key item (lodestone, elytra, golden carrot, slime block, lily pad). Radiation Shielding (chestplate): blocks all radiation, when radiation is switched on in the config.
tooltip.tieredpower.desc.geiger_counter: Radiation is optional and OFF by default - turn it on in the mod's config file ([radiation] enabled = true; strength sets how harsh it is). With it on, running fission reactors give off radiation within 16 blocks (much stronger up close), and carrying nuclear materials is radioactive too: depleted fuel rods most of all, then plutonium, MOX and uranium fuel rods, and a little from uranium itself. Your dose builds up while you're exposed and slowly fades once you're clear; dying resets it. At 100 rad you get nausea, at 300 weakness and hunger, at 600 poison, and from 1,000 rad you take damage. Protection: each piece of the Hazmat Suit (yellow wool and leather) blocks 25% - wear all four for full protection - or fit the Radiation Shielding Module to a Quantum Chestplate for complete protection. Hold the Geiger Counter to see the radiation reaching you (after shielding) and your dose - it clicks faster the hotter it gets. Iodine Tablets (salt and dried kelp) remove 300 rad each.
